slides.title: Everything a phone shop does *in a day*.
slides.body: One system for the counter, the drawers and the books.
slides.sub_ar: كل ما يحتاجه محل الخليوي في يومه

items.d: Fast checkout, barcodes, stock levels, and phones tracked by IMEI.
Prices, payments, change and drawers in USD and LBP.
Send and receive transfers with fees worked out.
Sell on credit, take repayments in either currency, see who owes what.
Repair jobs from intake to pickup, with the parts used.
Find any sold item by customer, phone, receipt number or serial.
Close each drawer and see the profit from every part of the shop.

slides.title: Want to see it in *your shop*?
slides.body: Message us — we'll show you how it works and talk about pricing.

caption_en:
Everything a phone shop does in a day, in one system 👇

• Sales and stock, phones tracked by IMEI
• Dollars and lira together
• OMT and Whish transfers, fees worked out
• MTC and Alfa credit and days
• Customer debts
• Repairs from intake to pickup
• Warranty on any item
• Daily closing and profits

Use the desktop app in the shop, or sign in from any browser.

Want to see it in your shop? Message us on WhatsApp: +961 81 077 357 (link in bio).
